high_level_description: This image depicts a hospital ward with multiple patients lying on hospital beds. The setting appears to be a busy and somewhat crowded ward, as there are several beds occupied by patients, each covered with blue blankets. In the foreground, a patient is lying on a bed, with their legs extended towards the camera. Their feet are bare, and they have a piece of paper placed on their lap. A hand is visible, resting on their leg, with an orange bandage or tape applied to the wrist, indicating that the person might be receiving intravenous therapy.
